doc: ColorPickerMode selects the color space of the area and the hue bar of a [ColorPicker].

0.doc: ColorPickerModeHSV uses the hue, saturation and value of the HSV color space, the default.
0.name: ColorPickerModeHSV

1.doc: ColorPickerModeHCT uses the hue, chroma and tone of the HCT color space.
1.name: ColorPickerModeHCT
